input.title: Add alt text to hero image of handmade mugs
input.rationale: The hero image has no alt attribute, so screen readers may read out the file name instead. The image shows three cream speckled mugs with brown rims on a wooden shelf. This is the shop's own pottery and it backs up the heading "Handmade pottery for everyday use", so it carries meaning and isn't decorative. The proposed alt text says what the image shows in a few words and doesn't repeat the nearby heading or paragraph. The image contains no text that needs including. A reviewer should check that the wording fits the brand.
